name: Dr. Aarav & Priya Sharma
title: An enchanting, fairytale honeymoon in Kashmir!
review: Our honeymoon in Kashmir was truly magical! From the moment we landed in Srinagar, the City Line team took exceptional care of us. The candle-lit dinner on the cedar houseboat and the Gondola experience in Gulmarg were beyond words. Personalized, courteous, and always reachable.

name: Rajesh & Meenakshi Patel
title: Top-tier care for elderly parents & seamless vehicles
review: We traveled as a family of six including my elderly parents. City Line arranged a clean, comfortable Innova and ensured that every hotel had proper winter heating and warm hospitality. Betaab Valley and Sonamarg glaciers were breathtaking. Highly recommended for genuine Kashmir travel!

name: Ananya Sen & Friends
title: Pure serenity in Doodhpathri with no commercial rush
review: Doodhpathri and Yusmarg were so peaceful and pristine! No commercial rush, just fresh pine air, crystal streams, and warm Kashmiri Kahwa. The City Line driver knew all the scenic secret viewpoints and photo spots. Thank you for an authentic Kashmiri experience.

name: Rohan & Kavita Varma
title: Shikara sunrise & private houseboat were unforgettable
review: The morning Shikara cruise on Dal Lake as the mist cleared over Zabarwan mountains was a highlight of our lives. Our chauffeur Shabir was polite, always on time, and gave us the best recommendations for authentic saffron and Kashmiri shawls without any sales pressure.

name: Sundar & Lakshmi Raman
title: Reliable arrangements, Jain & pure veg food coordinated
review: We were concerned about food and mountain roads for our family. City Line coordinators took personal responsibility: every single resort had pure vegetarian options ready for us, electric blankets in cold Pahalgam nights, and courteous staff. 10/10 service!

name: Arjun Nair & Group
title: Gulmarg Phase 2 Gondola & Apharwat powder snow was insane
review: We were a group of 5 college buddies visiting for snow sports. City Line helped us secure our Gondola Phase 2 tickets smoothly and arranged ski rental with certified instructors. Apharwat at 14,000 ft was sensational. Best winter trip ever.

name: Tenzing & Shalini Roy
title: Razdan Pass & Habba Khatoon peak took our breath away
review: Gurez Valley is unlike anywhere on earth. Gazing at Habba Khatoon peak reflecting in the Kishanganga river was spiritual. City Line coordinated our inner-line permissions and stay in log wood cottages seamlessly. Real local mastery of Kashmir.

name: Tariq & Farzana Siddiqui
title: Booked from Dubai: absolute 5-star coordination throughout
review: Planning a Kashmir trip from the UAE felt daunting until we contacted City Line. Transparent quotation, spotless Toyota Crysta with a gentle driver, top-tier luxury houseboat, and 24/7 responsiveness on WhatsApp. Will recommend to all our friends in the Gulf.
